faq.q: How does the live preview run my JavaScript safely?
faq.a: The preview renders in a sandboxed iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts". Your JS executes but can't touch the editor page around it, and because it's isolated, outside stylesheets don't apply and a CSS reset isn't inherited. Network requests from your code may be blocked by the sandbox, and most cross-origin API calls will fail with a CORS error that isn't your bug.

faq.q: Is there a console, and will it show my errors?
faq.a: Yes. A bridge script in the preview forwards console.log, warn, error and info to the editor's Console panel below the preview, and window.onerror reports runtime errors with a line number. Your JS is also wrapped in a try/catch so a thrown error is logged rather than silently failing. Click 'Clear' to empty the console.

faq.q: What starter templates and snippets are included?
faq.a: Templates include Blank Page, Centred Card, Flexbox Layout, CSS Grid Gallery, Responsive Navbar, Contact Form, Landing Hero, CSS Animation and a JS Todo Demo. You can also save named snippets (stored under htmlEditorSnippets) and reload or delete them. Your current HTML/CSS/JS autosaves under htmlEditorV2, so your work survives a refresh.

faq.q: Does it have syntax help, formatting and responsive preview?
faq.a: The HTML pane has One Dark-style syntax highlighting, auto-closing brackets/quotes, auto-closing tags on typing '>' (skipping void elements like img and br), and Tab-to-indent. A 'Format' button beautifies the active pane. The preview has Desktop/Tablet (768px)/Mobile (375px) width buttons and a fullscreen toggle. You can copy all code or download a complete page.html.
